channel.title: Michael Moran — Cyber Security Professional
channel.description: Senior cyber security consultant. Government and high-value corporate engagements in mobile security, wireless analysis, network forensics, penetration testing, and security architecture.

item.title: Michael Moran — Cyber Security Professional
item.description: Trusted security asset where failure is not an option.

item.title: Profile
item.description: Operating at the intersection of government and enterprise, I bring a disciplined approach honed in high-assurance environments to complex security challenges across both public and private sectors. My work is defined by outcomes, not outputs.

item.title: Capability: Mobile & Device Security
item.description: Deep assessment of iOS, Android, and embedded device firmware across attack surface, runtime, and supply chains. Expertise spans application security, hardware interfaces, and secure boot chains.

item.title: Capability: Wireless/RF Analysis (TETRA, LTE, SDR)
item.description: Radio frequency and telecommunications protocol analysis. I intercept, decode, and model wireless attack surfaces, with experience in critical communications infrastructure and cellular network security.

item.title: Capability: Network Forensics & Traffic Analysis
item.description: Post-incident reconstruction and adversary behaviour modelling. I extract actionable intelligence from packet captures, flow data, and network logs to understand the full scope of compromise.

item.title: Capability: Penetration Testing & Red Team
item.description: Adversary-emulation exercises and comprehensive penetration testing. I focus on realistic threat scenarios, privilege escalation, and lateral movement with clear remediation guidance.

item.title: Capability: Security Architecture & Hardening
item.description: Design and review of security controls across cloud, network, and application layers. I produce architectures that balance risk reduction with operational requirements.

item.title: Capability: Incident Response
item.description: Containment, eradication, and recovery from security incidents. I provide structured playbooks and post-incident analysis to strengthen defences against recurrence.

item.title: Engagement: Wireless Security Assessment at National Infrastructure Operator
item.description: Reduced attack surface for a national communications infrastructure provider through comprehensive LTE/TETRO RF analysis and protocol-level vulnerability identification.

item.title: Engagement: Mobile Application Penetration Test at Financial Services Group
item.description: Identified and remediated critical vulnerabilities in iOS and Android banking applications prior to production release, preventing potential credential theft vectors.

item.title: Engagement: Network Forensics & Incident Response at Government Department
item.description: Reconstructed a multi-stage compromise across classified networks, enabling complete containment and informing new detection controls for the intelligence chain.

item.title: Engagement: Security Architecture Review at Healthcare Provider
item.description: Redesigned zero-trust architecture for a regional health system, achieving compliance with data protection regulations while maintaining clinical workflow integrity.

item.title: Testimonial 1
item.description: Michael delivered exceptional wireless security analysis for our critical infrastructure program. His technical expertise and discretion were invaluable.

item.title: Testimonial 2
item.description: The penetration test identified vulnerabilities we would have missed. Michael's detailed reporting made remediation straightforward.

item.title: Testimonial 3
item.description: Professional, thorough, and discreet. Michael navigated complex government security requirements with expertise.
